name: @azure-functions-agents/vally-executor
description: Vally executor for Azure Functions Agents Runtime chat endpoints.

scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs').then(({rmSync}) => { rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); rmSync('test-dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); })"
scripts.test: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test test-dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:cli: npm run build && node test/cli-smoke.mjs && node test/tool-grader-smoke.mjs
